entries.text: The Endermen speak distorted English phrases played backwards.
The Ghast's sounds are made by a cat named C418's cat.
Herobrine has never been in vanilla Minecraft.
The End was originally called 'Sky Dimension'.
Creepers were created by accident when Notch tried to make a pig.
The Warden is the first blind mob in Minecraft.
Endermen were inspired by Slender Man.
The Nether was once called 'The Nexus' and 'Hell'.
Minecraft's world is 8 times the surface area of Earth.
The Far Lands existed until Beta 1.8.
Notch's original name for Minecraft was 'Cave Game'.
The Ender Dragon's name is Jean.
Zombie Pigmen were renamed to Zombified Piglins in 1.16.
The music disc '11' is intentionally corrupted and creepy.
Silverfish have been hiding in strongholds since Beta 1.8.
The Deep Dark biome was inspired by the Skulk Catalyst.
Ancient Cities contain loot that hints at a forgotten civilization.
The Wither was the first boss mob added after the Ender Dragon.
Piglins are afraid of Soul Fire but not regular fire.
The End poem was written by Julian Gough.
Bats are the smallest mob in Minecraft.
The Guardian was the first hostile underwater mob.
Chorus fruit can teleport you through walls.
The original Minecraft world height was only 128 blocks.
Diamonds spawn most commonly at Y-level -59.
The Ender Dragon egg is the rarest item in survival.
Striders are the only mob that can walk on lava.
The Axolotl can play dead to regenerate health.
Wardens can one-shot players in full Netherite armor.
Trial Chambers are procedurally generated structures.
